evidence: Let a,b be incomparable minima below both incomparable maxima c,d. Its seven order ideals are empty, {a}, {b}, {a,b}, {a,b,c}, {a,b,d}, and {a,b,c,d}. The standard projective Hibi ideal has exactly the two incomparable-pair relations z_a*z_b=z_empty*z_ab and z_abc*z_abd=z_ab*z_abcd; its projective variety is the normal-fan toric variety of the order polytope of this poset.

For the two Hibi quadrics q1=z_a*z_b-z_empty*z_ab and q2=z_abc*z_abd-z_ab*z_abcd, direct rank<2 of the 2-by-7 Jacobian produces exactly five projective coordinate lines, supported on (z_empty,z_a), (z_empty,z_b), (z_empty,z_abcd), (z_abc,z_abcd), (z_abd,z_abcd). They meet three at z_empty and three at z_abcd, and nowhere else. At a general side line one quadric is a local parameter and the other is a split rank-four quadric; at a general central line z_empty=1 eliminates z_ab=z_a*z_b, giving z_abc*z_abd-lambda*z_a*z_b=0 (lambda=z_abcd nonzero), likewise an ordinary threefold node in every characteristic. These five are precisely edges 012-021, 012-102, 012-210, 210-120, 210-201. This is a direct finite specialization of Wagner and Hibi, not an unaddressed original conifold theorem.
Wagner Theorem 2.3, Corollary 2.4, and Theorem 3.2 explicitly address exactly the projective toric order-polytope model, not only the semigroup affine cone.

originality.rationale: A decisive prior mathematical implication was missed by the source self-review. The audited ASM3 polytope is integrally equivalent, by a checked four-coordinate map, to the order polytope of the 2+2 poset. Its projective normal-fan toric fourfold is therefore the Hibi variety governed by Wagner (1996). The standard Hibi straightening relations reduce the very same variety to two quadrics in P6. Their elementary Jacobian calculation reproduces ALL FIVE listed singular invariant lines, the two trivalent points, and the ordinary threefold-node transverse germs, in all characteristics. Wagner 1996 already supplies the general singular-stratum and local-ring machinery for all posets, so the present enumeration is a covered finite specialization, despite absence of literally identical wording or component labels in the earlier paper. Explicit 4x4 coordinates may be useful exposition but are not a surviving new mathematical theorem under the required originality standard.
residual_risks: The exact ASM3-to-2+2 Hibi affine isomorphism may not have been stated explicitly in Wagner or Striker, but it is a one-matrix integral relabelling and does not rescue the covered singularity classification.
The Hibi equations are considered as the projective normal-fan variety; they must not be confused with the affine cone or the Birkhoff polytope.
No absolute historical claim about every possible source is needed; a decisive earlier universal mathematical theorem already covers the substance.

value.rationale: The object is canonical and a five-curve node arrangement is mathematically illustrative. However, under the narrow-exact-invariant value test, these counts and germs are already mechanically implied by Wagner’s all-poset singularity theorem once the tiny four-element 2+2 identification is made. The entire displayed geometry also follows immediately from the two classical Hibi quadrics by an elementary Jacobian computation. Beyond this worked substitution and 4x4 unimodular coordinate change, no substantively motivated missing invariant, structural principle, or independent mathematical gap survives the known general theory. This is a textbook-sized specialization, not a new valuable standalone mathematical finding; that determination is distinct from correctness and from merely not finding a matching title.
residual_risks: A clear exposition of the example could still have pedagogical usefulness, which is not the same as the user-required independent scientific value of an original finding.
No downstream generalization is required in principle; the failure is the existing complete general implication, not small dimension alone.

limitations: The original claim is mathematically correct but covered by Wagner 1996 after a tiny exact affine bridge to Hibi 2+2.
Striker original n3 coordinates/facets and Hibi order/chain equivalence are established inputs; the five-curve computation is an elementary specialization, not an independent new result.
No claim of scheme-theoretic Jacobian singular subscheme, nongeneric fixed-point completed analytic germs, or n>3 classification.
